# Principal Handoff 0.4 (vendored)

The record schemas of Principal Handoff Core 0.4 and its Acts 0.4 and Decisions 0.4 extensions, and their
`records.json` conformance cases, copied unchanged from the specification at tag `principal-handoff-0.4` (commit
8d7b988). Licensed under the Apache License 2.0, as the version beside it (`../principal-handoff/LICENSE`, `NOTICE`).

Muninn speaks 0.5 (`../principal-handoff/`). These are the version before, which a project may still speak during the
transition (core 0.5 section 14): its records are checked under 0.4's own rules, and what Muninn tells it is converted
to 0.4 and checked against these schemas before it is told.
